author: speedminer
body:
my name is speedminer

So I was playing the walls and I was flying and I got banned what I said before was a lie sorry

sorry for who every reading this and the last one I promise I will never fly ever again and if I do please  banned me for life I'm really sorry for lying I just really wanted to play on that server again.

About coolsurfman that is my brothers account and one day his computer broke so we are sharing at the moment until he gets a new one that's what happened there

reason I should be allowed back
I will never do again
favourite server
I'm really sorry and I mean it
hope you forgive
thank for the good memories with my brother

regards
speedmier

replies.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your honesty. But I'd like to point out that you have only been banned for a short while, and that we simply can't take your word. You can try appeal this in a couple of months, but before that, please don't bother us by sending in another appeal.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
